mentl/7865469:
m3's second assembly attempt (run #21) refused at ft_name: $call_2503
declared three times. The e-graph shares pure nodes, so one LCall node
sat at three DAG positions; the locals walk carried TWO disciplines —
named locals set-deduped, but handle-suffixed scratch ($call_/$tuple_/
$simd_/$variant_/$sst_/$__hstate_/$__fb_) STREAMED INLINE on the false
premise 'unique by construction' — and declared the register once per
position. The seam between the two disciplines was the bug.

The whole-form fix: one discipline. Every local — named and
handle-suffixed alike — collects into the accumulated set and
emit_named_locals declares each distinct entry once. A handle keys ONE
register regardless of how many positions reach it (the atomic
set-then-use per occurrence makes sharing safe), so declaring it once is
the only correct form. walk_locals is now purely accumulative; the
inline wat_emit streams are gone. Named peer Hβ.emit.shared-node-cse for
the deeper ultimate (emit a shared pure node once and bind it, retiring
re-emission) — dedup-the-decl is its correct floor, since the e-graph
gates sharing on purity so no effect is ever duplicated.

mentl/78075ee:
The B.5 multi-shot quartet's final piece. Three peer handlers for
!Alloc × MultiShot composition per AM walkthrough §1.1 + §1.2 + §1.3.
Closes the multi-shot quartet — H7 (commits 4236b96 + ad78384 +
bafd63a) + CE (commit 55553ad) + HC2 (commit 3da8d79) + AM (this).

Per AM §0 + DESIGN Ch 6 D.1: arenas (per H4 region_tracker) give
bounded-lifetime allocation; MultiShot (per H7) gives speculative
resumes; the composition is non-trivial because a continuation
captured inside an arena could outlive the arena's region. AM
resolves with three peer policies:

- replay_safe — no continuation capture; trail-replay from install
  point per primitive #1's existing checkpoint substrate. Pure
  `!Alloc` over the arena. The kernel-canonical default.
- fork_deny — compile-time refusal at MS perform site if any capture
  holds an arena-scoped ref whose region is the current arena's
  region. Recommended default for shallow captures.
- fork_copy — deep-copy captures into target_arena (defaults to
  parent arena per Q-B.5.2; override via fork_copy(target)). Most
  expressive; pays O(M) per arena-scoped capture at perform time.

Per AM §1.5: `!Alloc × MS ⇒ replay_safe only` is the row invariant.
fork_deny + fork_copy ALLOCATE (continuation record + deep-copies);
they can't compose with `!Alloc`. Mentl's Trace tentacle surfaces
this contradiction at install time when the row contradicts.

Per Q-B.5.1 (defer MS+GC finalization to F.4 GC-landing) + Q-B.5.2
(auto parent-arena default; user override via fork_copy(target)).

Substrate landings:

tokensafe/78c4501:
The engine already Ed25519-signs every verdict (response_signature + signer_pubkey
in /v1/check) but had no way to verify it and the key was ephemeral. Add
verifyResponse() (recomputes the exact canonical sha256 digest, ed25519-verifies
against the in-process pubkey, fail-safe on bad input) and a free, stateless
POST /v1/verify that returns {valid, signer_pubkey} — POST back the signed fields
from any /v1/check response. Add scripts/generate-signing-key.ts (npm run
signing-key:generate) to mint a persistent RESPONSE_SIGNING_KEY so attestations
survive deploys. Turns the deterministic+signed engine into a verifiable moat
aggregators (reselling third-party grades) structurally can't match.
